How to play

Press Space or ↑, or click the sky, to flap through the gaps.

  • Each pair of pillars counts as one gate. Gaps vary more as you progress.
  • Avoid the pillars, ground, and ceiling.
  • Earn stars at 5, 15, and 30 gates. Pass 30 to win, including on replays.
  • Each new star gives 10 coins, once. Rewards stay saved after every round.

P or Escape pauses or resumes. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
